case_title: LAURIE ZAVADIL ET AL VS. MARIAN LIM

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-16-2021 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-16-2021 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFFS LAURIE ZAVADIL AND ANTHONY ZAVADIL ARE PRESENT. DEFENDANT MARIAN LIM IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY HER DAUGHER KAREN TASHIMA WITH WITNESS GREG LEON, PROPERTY MANAGER. HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG ALLOWS THE DAUGHTER OF THE DEFENDANT TO APPEAR ON HER BEHALF. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,880.00 FILED BY ZAVADIL, LAURIE ZAVADIL, ANTHONY AS TO DEFENDANT LIM, MARIAN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-16-2021 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $70.00) SERVED JUL-26-2021, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT LIM, MARIAN
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-16-2021 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF ZAVADIL, LAURIE ZAVADIL, ANTHONY RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT LIM, MARIAN $1,780.00 PRINCIPAL, $120.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,900.00, PLEASE SEE ATTACHED MC-025 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT LIM, MARIAN
